verdict.rationale: Lever's first-party Advanced Nurture page claims automated personalized outreach at scale and automatic follow-up with previous candidates. That covers the core of email sequencing and re-engagement nurture. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though, and does not document prospect pools or email tracking. Missing for 10: documented talent pools/prospect lists, email open/reply tracking, explicit nurture campaigns targeted at future roles, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, sourcing lives in a talent CRM — pools of prospects, personalized email sequences with tracking, and nurture campaigns for future roles

citations.quote: Automate personalized outreach at scale and devote direct attention to every candidate.
Lever helps you immediately reconnect with previous candidates and follow up automatically.
Lever's Automation Hub handles routine tasks like archiving, tagging, emailing, and advancing candidates.
